1. Vikram asal mein kis cheez ke liye message kar raha tha, aur uske pehle do messages ki kaunsi details yeh dikhati hain? Uske aakhri do replies ka kya matlab hai?

1. **Vikram asal mein kis cheez ke liye message kar raha tha, aur uske pehle do messages ki kaunsi details yeh dikhati hain? Uske aakhri do replies ka kya matlab hai?**  
   Vikram asal mein **UPSC Civil Services Examination ke result mein fail hone** aur **apne career ke do or attempts na bachne** ke baare mein message kar raha tha. Yeh details dikhati hain:  
   - "result aa gaya. list mein nahi hoon." → woh kisi competitive exam (most likely UPSC) mein fail hua.  
   - "woh last attempt tha" → uska koi attempt limit khatam ho gayi.  
   - "dus saal bhai. papa ka retirement fund delhi coaching mein gaya" → usne 10 saal UPSC ki taiyari mein laga diye, aur papa ke retirement funds bhi coaching mein khatam kar diye.  
   - "puri gali ab mazak mein collector sahab bulati hai" → log usse mazaak udaate hain ki woh collector banne ki koshish kar raha tha.  

   **Uske aakhri do replies ka matlab:**  
   - "haan. shayad." → Aman ke options (state PCS, SSC CGL, CAT) par Vikram ne **kuch conviction nahi dikhayi**, bas half-hearted agreement di.  
   - "haan theek hai. chal baad mein baat karte hain." → Vikram **conversation khatam karna chahta hai** kyunki woh emotional state mein hai aur Aman ke "logical" solutions se connect nahi kar pa raha.

2. **Aman se exactly kahan galti hui? Uske har move ko evaluate karo — alternatives, cousin ka example, "discipline" wali line, "dus darwaze" wali line.**  
   **Galti:** Aman ne Vikram ke **emotional pain ko validate nahi kiya** aur seedha "solution" mode mein chala gaya. Vikram ko empathy nahi, balki sunne wale ki zaroorat thi.  

   - **Alternatives (state PCS, SSC CGL):** Yeh options technically sahi hain, lekin Vikram abhi 10 saal ki failure ke shock mein hai. Usse pehle uske dard ko samjha jaana chahiye tha.  
   - **Cousin ka example (28 mein CAT → IIM Indore):** Yeh example Vikram ko aur bura laga, kyunki usne 10 saal laga diye, aur cousin ne kam time mein kuch haasil kiya. Yeh comparison insulting laga.  
   - **"Discipline aur GK toh mila" wali line:** Yeh **tone-deaf** hai. Vikram ne apna career, paisa aur respect kho diya, aur Aman usse "discipline" ka credit de raha hai. Yeh uski feelings ko trivialize karta hai.  
   - **"Dus darwaze" wali line:** Yeh cliché hai. Vikram ke liye abhi ek darwaza (UPSC) band hua hai, aur Aman usse "dus darwaze" ka philosophical pep talk de raha hai, jo emotional moment mein irrelevant lagta hai.  

   **Overall:** Aman ne **listen nahi kiya**, **validate nahi kiya**, aur **premature problem-solving** kiya.

3. **Aman ko ab repair ke liye jo message bhejna chahiye, bilkul waisa likho jaisa use bhejna chahiye.**  

   "Vikram, main sorry bolta hoon. Maine pehle sahi se suna nahi. 10 saal ka time aur papa ka retirement fund — yeh koi joke nahi hai. Tujhe abhi bahut bura lag raha hoga, aur maine usko ignore karke seedhe options batane laga. Tera pain valid hai. Aaj raat milte hain? Chai pe baith ke jo bolna hai, sun loon ga. Phir dheere dheere plan banayenge, lekin pehle tu apna dard share kar le."
